question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1. **
solution: The correct answer is: **Produced** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **'Produced' **refers to bringing forth, generating, or yielding a result or outcome. (किसी परिणाम या परिणाम को सामने लाना, या उत्पन्न करना) • **Example**: The research study produced valuable insights into the effects of the new medication. • In this context, "produced" is the appropriate word because it fits with the idea of causing or generating an effect. • Using "produced" suggests that travelling is actively causing or generating this effect on the mind. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Appeared: **To come into sight; to become visible or noticeable. (दृष्टि में आना; दृश्य या ध्यान देने योग्य हो जाना) • **Created: **To bring into existence; to make or produce. (अस्तित्व में लाना; बनाना या उत्पादन करना) • **Ingrained: **Deeply fixed or established; firmly rooted. (गहराई से स्थिर या स्थापित; मजबूत जड़ें) 3e:T8af, The correct answer is: **Interest**
